{{Top|canon=vibrocleaver}}
The '''vibro-cleaver''' was a type of implement.<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds}}</ref> Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. ''[[Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds|Into the Storm Clouds]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']] is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> three [[Chef/Legends|chefs]],<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds" /> including the head chef [[Pappi]],<ref name="The Air Up Thaere">{{LivingForce|Looking In: The Air Up Thaere}}</ref> who worked in the kitchen of ''[[Conkesta]]'', a floating [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], were equipped with vibro-cleavers.<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds" /> Pappi later also carried a vibro-cleaver while working in the [[Burnout Cafetorium]], the cafeteria of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Pappi had a habit whereby while talking he would toss his vibro-cleaver into the air and then catch it. The vibro-cleaver could also be wielded in combat as a weapon.<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" />
